# Pull Request Template

## Title
<!-- Provide a clear and concise title for the PR, e.g., "Add user authentication endpoint" or "Fix bug in payment processing" -->

## Description
<!-- Explain what this PR does, why it’s needed, and what problem it solves. Keep it brief but informative. -->
- **What**: [Describe the changes made]
- **Why**: [Explain the reason or context for the changes]
- **Impact**: [Mention the affected components, modules, or features]

## JIRA Details
<!-- Provide the JIRA issue number and a direct link to the JIRA ticket. -->
- **JIRA Number**: [e.g., PROJ-123]
- **JIRA Link**: [e.g., https://yourcompany.atlassian.net/browse/PROJ-123]

## Related Issues
<!-- Link to any related issues or tickets (e.g., GitHub Issues, additional JIRA tickets). -->
- Closes #[issue_number]
- Related to #[issue_number]

## Changes Made
<!-- List the key changes in a bullet-point format for clarity. -->
- [Change 1]
- [Change 2]
- [Change 3]

## Testing
<!-- Describe how the changes were tested or how reviewers can test them. -->
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Integration tests passed
- [ ] Manual testing performed: [Describe steps or scenarios tested]
- [ ] Tested on: [e.g., Chrome, Node v18, etc.]

## Screenshots (if applicable)
<!-- Include screenshots or GIFs for UI changes or visual updates. -->
[Attach or link screenshots here]

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests have been added or updated
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (if applicable)

- [ ] Changes have been reviewed locally
- [ ] No merge conflicts

<!-- Add any extra information, such as risks, dependencies, or follow-up tasks. -->
